{{Otheruses|Grand Hall}}
The '''Grand Hall of the Trader's Guild''', also known as the '''Grand Halls''', was a building in [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]] on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. When [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces seized the city, the building was converted into a [[Self-Constructing Armament Factory|factory]] for [[Mankvim-814 light interceptor/Legends|Mankvim-814 light interceptors]] by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]].
